title: Salt and Ember
author: G. M. Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Pemberton, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
